NOTICE.TITLE: Regulation (EU) 2024/1 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 1 January 2024 on test compliance requirements for EU financial institutions
NOTICE.CONTENTS: Article 1 - Scope. This regulation establishes test compliance requirements for EU financial institutions operating under the supervision of competent authorities. Article 2 - Definitions. For the purposes of this regulation, compliance means adherence to applicable regulatory requirements as defined by EBA guidelines and EBA technical standards. Article 3 - Requirements. Financial institutions shall implement adequate internal controls, reporting mechanisms, and governance frameworks by the effective date stated herein.
